verdict.rationale: Embedding in-person payments in a third-party app is a fair question for a POS and payments product, so the axis applies. However, the evidence shows no official mobile SDK for doing this in your own app. POS UI extensions only add functionality inside Shopify's own POS app, and Tap to Pay is a feature of that app, so both are adjacent rather than the capability itself.

support.subject: As a developer, I can embed in-person payments into my own iOS or Android app with official mobile SDKs
